capabilities: Fill weekly tasks from a monthly calendar
Track task completion and hours per day
Edit tasks and sub-tasks in a day panel
Sync two-way between calendar and Markdown file
Diagnose file inconsistencies without changing them
extras: Documentation includes install steps, file format rules, and a limitations section noting unsupported date formats and untested UI code.
motivation: No more copying last week's template and re-typing the headings.
problem: Obsidian's daily-note and task workflows require copying templates and re-typing week headings instead of filling a weekly view directly.
summary: Calendar-based weekly task tracker that writes tasks, checkboxes, and hours into a single Markdown file you can edit by hand.
